messages:
emma: Uploaded the security assessment artifacts for the customer vendor review. Secure share: https://files.redwood.com/s/abc123 (expires in 30d). Included: full-report.pdf, triage-sheet.xlsx, vuln-scan.zip, exploit-poec.tar.gz. pinging @raj for remediation ETA and @oliver for customer comms.

raj: Thanks — downloading now. Does the triage sheet include CVSS, owners, and PR links?

emma: Yes. Triage has columns: vuln_id, cvss, severity, status (open/in-progress/fixed), owner, pr_link, notes. Sheet link: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1xyz

sasha: I'll take the high/critical re-tests. Plan: start criticals today. Preliminary ETA: criticals finished in 3 business days, highs by end of next week (dev bandwidth permitting).

oliver: I'll tell the customer we have a remediation timeline. Any PII or sensitive data inside the artifacts? Need to confirm for their legal team.

sasha: No PII — exploit POCs were sanitized. Verified by @security-bot.

security-bot: SCAN-BOT: external-scan completed 2026-03-20. Summary: 2 critical, 5 high, 8 medium. Exported details to vuln-scan.zip.

raj: I'll coordinate fix PRs and owners. Quick assignment: sasha -> critical-1 (session fixation), leah -> critical-2 (auth bypass), dev-team -> highs. I've added a "Remediation Plan" tab in the triage sheet with tasks.

leah: Started work on auth bypass. Opened PR #4321. Requesting review from infra.

emma: Can we produce a customer-facing evidence bundle by end of week? They want: original report, remediation summary, retest screenshots, and signed attestation.

oliver: Customer expects the packet plus a signed attestation from Legal. Legal needs ~48h to prepare the attestation once we hand them the summary.

sasha: I'll capture retest logs and a short runbook. For reproducible evidence we'll include commands like: ```bash
nmap -sV -p 443 <target>
curl -sSf https://internal.retest/critical-1/verify.json
``` and trimmed exploit run logs.

emma: Proposed timeline: Critical fixes by 2026-03-23 18:00 UTC, retests done by 2026-03-24 12:00 UTC, evidence package to customer by 2026-03-25. Anyone object?

oliver: That works. I'll tell them to expect attestation by 2026-03-27 (legal buffer).

raj: Noted; I'll update the sheet and ping if we hit blockers. @leah please confirm CI capacity for the urgent PRs.

leah: CI queued; may need to bump priority. If CI blocks, I'll run retests locally in a container. PR review ETA ~6h.

emma: Uploading interim evidence now to the secure share and adding a README with reproduction steps. :thumbsup:

sasha: Also adding a consolidated severity summary table to the sheet for the vendor portal (critical:2, high:5, medium:8).

oliver: Please cc me on the final packet so I can attach to the deal record and send to their security lead.

security-bot: ALERT: dependency update available — lib-crypto v2.1.4 -> v2.1.5. Marked as low in current triage but recommended.

raj: I'll add a task for lib-crypto to the next sprint; aim to fold into medium vuln patch.

leah: Merged PR #4321. Deployed to staging and started retest.

sasha: Re-test update: critical-1 is fixed, critical-2 mitigated but requires a config rollback on prod window. Uploading retest logs to the share.

emma: Final evidence package uploaded: https://files.redwood.com/s/def456 (password-protected). I'll send the password via the secure channel to the customer's security contact. :white_check_mark:

oliver: Thanks all. I'll coordinate the handoff with the customer's security lead tomorrow morning and confirm receipt.

raj: Closing loop — triage sheet updated with final statuses and PR links. If anything else pops up I will ping here.

leah: If legal needs any change logs or signatures on PRs, let me know and I can export a commit histogram.

emma: Great teamwork everyone. We'll keep the customer posted and shift to post-delivery monitoring after attestation.
